clips.title: The story
paras: Baron Silverlaine's spirit lingers in the Great Hall above Pyrewood Village. He once ruled Silverlaine Keep, until Archmage Arugal unleashed worgen upon the region and they slaughtered him.

Baron Silverlaine ruled a noble estate in the southern hills of Silverpine. His fortress guarded the surrounding lands and kept them safe. That peace ended when Archmage Arugal summoned worgen to fight the rampaging Scourge and unleashed them upon the region. The feral beasts could not be controlled. They stormed the stronghold, overwhelmed its guards, and butchered the baron.

Baron Silverlaine remains bound to the keep's ancient Great Hall. His restless ghost wanders among the wrecked dining tables where he once feasted. The cursed lord attacks intruders who enter his former home.
